description: Fontaines à boire - GPS is a dataset listed in Opendata de Grand Paris Sud open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by GPS et communes. Liste des fontaines à boire sur le territoire de Grand Paris Sud. Coverage: Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne). The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are fontaine, eau. The portal shows 12 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2022-04-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-grandparissud-fr-portal.
